Mixed: take-1 move with its pile update is sensible, but includes take-2 legality oddly.
Hurts: near-duplicate of A2 missing succ(0,1); redundant and arbitrary.
Neutral: helper predicates grouped, but redundant with A2 and A5.
Helps: counting facts kept together as one clear helper group.
Helps: pile starts at five and shrinks by takes; coherent pile rule.
Helps: turn alternation with first player starting is a clean, nameable rule.

Slightly hurts: atleast2 helper alone is fragmentary, though readable.
